title: Flag Pole Holder Brackets, BONWIN 1" Flag Pole Mounting Bracket with Hardwares for House Wall Mount, 1" Inner Diameter, Two Positions & Aluminium Alloy, Rust Free Coated (Black - 1 Pack)

reviews.title: Good flag holder, chinzy screws
reviews.body: These are just fine. Not chinzy at all. I bought a total of a dozen of them for a flag display of American and military flags for the 4th of July.The first 6 were decent quality and price point enough that I bought 6 more.I like that you can use them for regular flag flying and also for half mast flag flying.The screws that come with them are stupidly chinzy compared to the actual holder. I HIGHLY suggest you purchase better screws before installing them. I bent the first 2, even with a pilot hole. LOL So, the screws are junk, but the actual holder is good and heavy duty.

features: BONWIN 1 Pack Heavy Duty Flag Pole Holders: Made of durable thickened aluminum alloy with strong rust free coated, precision polishing process, smoother surface. It has extra wind resistant and lasting rust free. Perfect flagpole hardware for outdoor house garden. Available in White Black Silver.

Two-Positions Flagpole Bracket: 2 Positions hole design, can be installed with 45 degree upwards angle or 90 degree vertical angle. Allow you freely switch the angle of the flagpole, our wall mount flagpole holders will help you better show your love flag.

Fit For 1" Diameter Flagpole: The inner diameter is 1.024 inch. Specially designed for standard 1 inch wood or metal flagpoles, rust-proof, wind-proof and waterproof, can be used safely outdoors. The stable thickened bottom plate and 40mm long screws are very sturdy to hold 7FT 1" flag pole and 4x6FT flag.

Easy to Install: Included 6 high-hardness carbon steel screws, 6 anchors, 2 butterfly screw. Strong hardware kit can be mounted on any surface. Mark the drilling position first; use your own 6mm drill bit for drilling (not included), and drill 2 inches deep; then fix flagpole bracket by installing screws and anchors into the holes, finally use butterfly screw to fix flagpole easily.

Wide Outdoor Application: Suitable for all kinds of horizontal wall surfaces, such as wood, concrete and metal. Perfect for securing flag poles and your lovely America flag on your house walls, porch, patio, wooden pile, front yard, garden, roof or even your truck or boat. Great gift for Christmas, Birthdays, Parties, Thanksgiving Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day.
